body:
Filed by: Claude (AI agent) while implementing #4598. The operator chose this follow-up through the session manager on 2026-11-07.

## Context / Business Value

#4598 shards Lisa's own unit-test job (PR #4674, held). Sharding works: the four test legs run in parallel and the required check `🔍 Quality Checks / 🧪 Run Unit Tests` still reports. But the unit path took **13m55s**, against the epic's target of **8 minutes or less** (it was 20.9 min before).

Two problems hold #4674 back, and both are outside #4598's scope:

1. **The final unit-test job does about 4.5 minutes of serial extra work.** After the shards finish, the aggregate job `🧪 Run Unit Tests` runs six Lisa-only "Execute and name … regression specs" steps one after another. On run 42399251289 they took 24 s, 21 s, 18 s, 18 s, 43 s and 141 s, about 265 s in total, inside a 5m38s job. Those specs already run inside the shards. These steps only re-run them so the log names them. With them on the path, no shard count can get the unit path under 8 minutes.
2. **The review-evidence gate fails because of sharding.** With shards, `🧪 Run Unit Tests` only appears once every shard has finished, about 8 minutes in. The gate's 300 s registration wait expires first. On run 42399251122 it logged `13 of 14 required contexts observed (1 deferred by declaration: 🧩 Plugin artifacts match source); missing: 🔍 Quality Checks / 🧪 Run Unit Tests`. The check is not ruleset-required, but it goes red on this PR, and once #4674 merges it would likely go red on every Lisa PR, the same failure #4622 fixed for the plugin check.

## Technical Approach

- **Take the named regression specs off the unit path.** In `.github/workflows/quality.yml`, the six steps at about lines 2800–2875 (`Execute and name Node 24 regression specs` through `Execute and name completion authorization regression specs`) are guarded by `github.repository == 'CodySwannGT/lisa'` and run serially in the aggregate job after the shard merge. Move them into a new job, `🧾 Named Regression Specs`, that `🧪 Run Unit Tests` does not depend on. The new job needs only what the steps need today (checkout, Node/Bun setup, install), so it starts in parallel with the shards. It runs whatever `unit_test_shards` is. Use one job with the six steps as they are. Split it into a matrix only if its run on #4674 turns out to be the slowest unit-path leg. Keep the `github.repository == 'CodySwannGT/lisa'` guard, `--reporter=verbose`, and the rule that a failing step fails CI. Drop the `steps.gate_run.outcome == 'success'` condition, which refers to the aggregate job.
  - **Prove first** that no ruleset-required context or evidence check depends on these steps running inside `🧪 Run Unit Tests`. Check `.github/required-checks.json`. `tests/integration/quality-unit-test-shards-env-scope.test.ts` (around line 113) pins these six step names in the aggregate job. Update it in the same change so it asserts they are in the new job and absent from `🧪 Run Unit Tests`. Grep `tests/` for any other test that pins them.
  - **Unsharded callers** (`unit_test_shards: 1`) must keep working. The steps are Lisa-only and the new job runs at every shard count, so no host behaviour changes.
- **Defer the sharded aggregate's registration.** Add `🔍 Quality Checks / 🧪 Run Unit Tests` to `registration_deferred` in `.github/required-checks.json` (`#4622`'s mechanism, beside `🧩 Plugin artifacts match source` at about line 64), with a reason such as "sharded unit tests (unit_test_shards > 1) post the aggregate only after every shard finishes". It stays ruleset-required for merge; the gate simply stops waiting for it. Change only Lisa's own `.github/required-checks.json`. Hosts that set `unit_test_shards` may need the same entry. Do not edit host templates here. Name that possible host impact in the PR description, so it can be filed separately if it is real.
- **Then re-measure on #4674.** Rebase #4674 onto this change and read its CI with `gh run view <run-id> -R CodySwannGT/lisa --json jobs --jq '.jobs[] | select(.name | test("Unit")) | {name, conclusion, startedAt, completedAt}'`. If the path is still over 8 minutes, tune `unit_test_shards` in #4674 (2–20) as #4598 already allows.

## Acceptance Criteria

```gherkin
Scenario: The named regression specs no longer lengthen the unit path
  Given quality.yml runs the six "Execute and name … regression specs" steps outside the 🧪 Run Unit Tests job
  When a CodySwannGT/lisa pull request's 🔍 CI Quality Checks run completes
  Then the 🧪 Run Unit Tests job runs none of those steps
  And every one of those spec files is still executed and named in a job's log on that run
  And a failing named spec still fails that run

Scenario: The review-evidence gate passes its first run under unit sharding
  Given .github/required-checks.json lists "🔍 Quality Checks / 🧪 Run Unit Tests" under registration_deferred
  And ci.yml sets unit_test_shards greater than 1
  When the 🕵️ Review evidence gate runs on a pull request whose review completed
  Then it does not report 🧪 Run Unit Tests as an absent required check
  And main's ruleset still requires 🧪 Run Unit Tests for merge

Scenario: An unsharded caller is unchanged
  Given a caller of quality.yml with unit_test_shards set to 1
  When its unit job runs
  Then 🧪 Run Unit Tests still runs and enforces coverage thresholds as before
```

## Out of Scope

- Setting or tuning `unit_test_shards` in `ci.yml`. That stays in #4598 / PR #4674.
- Integration sharding (D2) and moving the packed-host journey (D3).
- Changing the review-evidence settle window itself (`SETTLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`).

## Target Backend Environment

None — no runtime behavior change: config-only

## Repository

CodySwannGT/lisa

## Links

Parent: #4587 (native sub-issue)
Blocks #4598
Relates to #4622
Relates to #4479
Evidence: PR #4674, CI run https://github.com/CodySwannGT/lisa/actions/runs/42399251289 (unit timing), review-evidence run https://github.com/CodySwannGT/lisa/actions/runs/42399251122

## Relationship Search

Searched 2026-11-07:
- `gh issue list --search "regression specs aggregate unit" --state open`: no results.
- `gh issue list --search "review evidence settle registration wait" --state all`: #4622 (closed; added `registration_deferred` for the plugin check, the mechanism reused here), #4527 (closed; added the registration wait), #3801 (closed; measured the settle window), #4547 and #4487 (closed; unrelated).
- `git log -3 origin/main -- .github/workflows/quality.yml`: `fda809883e test(rails): name hook installation regressions in CI` added one of the named-spec steps; no open work moves them.
- No duplicate found.
